Article 1 sets the scope of the MAH duty to comply with GPSP; statement described the Ordinance rather than stating the company duty.

row.title: Comply with GPSP when conducting post-marketing surveys and studies of prescription drugs
row.statement: MAHs and foreign special-approval holders must comply with the GPSP Ordinance in post-marketing survey and study activities for prescription drugs (as defined in Article 14(1) of the Enforcement Regulations, excluding in-vitro diagnostics and skin-applied drugs intended solely for diagnosis); the Ordinance also sets the standards for post-marketing survey and study data supporting re-examination and re-evaluation (except matters under the GCP Ordinance).

items.reason: Pure definition; restated as the scope of the MAH GPSP duties it sets.

row.title: Scope: apply GPSP to use-results surveys, post-marketing database surveys and post-marketing clinical trials
row.statement: The MAH or foreign special-approval holder must apply the GPSP requirements to its post-marketing surveys and studies, meaning surveys or studies it conducts to collect, detect, confirm or verify information on drug quality, efficacy and safety: use-results surveys, post-marketing database surveys and post-marketing clinical trials.

items.reason: Pure definition; restated as the scope of the GPSP use-results survey requirements.

row.title: Scope: GPSP use-results survey requirements cover general, specified and comparative use-results surveys
row.statement: The MAH must apply the GPSP use-results survey requirements to surveys using information collected from medical institutions in routine practice to detect or confirm the incidence of ADR-related diseases by type and quality, efficacy and safety information, comprising general surveys (no user conditions), specified surveys (users defined by conditions such as children, elderly, pregnant or nursing women, renal or hepatic impairment, long-term use) and comparative surveys (users vs non-users).

items.reason: Pure definition; restated as the scope of the GPSP database survey requirements.

row.title: Scope: GPSP post-marketing database survey requirements cover surveys using an operator-provided medical information database
row.statement: The MAH must apply the GPSP post-marketing database survey requirements (Article 6-2) to surveys that use a medical information database provided by a medical information database operator to detect or confirm the incidence of ADR-related diseases by type and quality, efficacy and safety information.

items.reason: Pure definition; restated as the scope of the GPSP post-marketing clinical trial requirements.

row.title: Scope: GPSP post-marketing clinical trial requirements cover trials within the approved dosage and indications
row.statement: The MAH must apply the GPSP post-marketing clinical trial requirements (Article 7, including GCP Article 56) to trials conducted in accordance with the approved dosage, administration, indications and effects to verify estimates from clinical trials, use-results surveys or database surveys, or to collect quality, efficacy and safety information not obtainable in routine practice.

items.reason: Pure definitions; restated as the scope they set for the MAH database survey duties.

row.title: Scope: medical information database and database operator for GPSP database surveys
row.statement: For GPSP database surveys, the MAH contracts with a medical information database operator (a person using a medical information database in its business), a medical information database being a systematically organised, computer-searchable collection of medical records, claims, disease registry and similar data gathered over a period.
